name: GameActivityToggle
description: Adds a button next to the mic and deafen button to toggle game activity. Right click it to toggle Spotify activity.
summary: A button next to mute and deafen that turns your game activity on and off; right-click for Spotify

settings.label: Old icon
settings.description: Use the old icon style before Discord icon redesign

notes: The button sits before mute and deafen and switches Discord's "Share your detected activities with others" (status.show_current_game, synced to your other devices): "Disable Game Activity" while it's on, "Enable Game Activity" with a red glow and a red slash while it's off. With Spotify connected, right-click lists "Share Spotify Activity" (with the account name when there are several) to switch each account's sharing (PATCH /users/@me/connections/spotify/{id}); the menu reflects a change at once, as upstream keeps local overrides.
gaps: Qt's SVG renderer has no masks, so the off icon draws the slash over the controller without upstream's gap around it.
The "Equicord Toolbox" location has no counterpart: Qord has no toolbox, so the button is always in the user panel.
